# Best MagSafe/Qi2 car mounts (as of Oct 2026)

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and rotates between portrait and landscape.
- It fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent slats need to be 3 mm thick or less and 20 mm deep or less. Vertical or shallow vents may sag.
- Buy: the Amazon links are in [RottenWiFi's guide](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) and [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/).

**Fastest and most reliable: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (Qi2 25W), $89.99 list**
- Thermoelectric cooling plus a fan helps prevent heat throttling.
- Mountguys uses it as their daily driver and says its vent clip is more secure than Belkin's or Apple's. [Mountguys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) says it ships with a 60W adapter.
- [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) listed it at $69.99 on sale, with Amazon links.
- 25W works only on newer iPhones (iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus). Older iPhones top out around 15W.
- It's not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or with cars that lack standard vent blades.
- Other roundups say a 45W+ car adapter is required, so confirm what's in the box.

**Best value: ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost (fan-cooled, 15W)**
- The Gadgeteer lists it at about $18.99, and elsewhere it's priced from about $32 to $36, so prices vary by listing.
- A car adapter is not included, which adds roughly $10–15.
- Buy: Amazon link in [The Gadgeteer's roundup](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).

**Best bundled power (25W): LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, $39.95**
- It comes with a 95W adapter and a large suction base for dashboards.
- The fan must stay on for 25W. With it off, output caps at 15W.
- Buy: Amazon link in [The Gadgeteer's roundup](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).

**Other situations**
- **No charging, just a sturdy hold:** the VICSEED steel-core vent mount, per [Mountguys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/).
- **Trucks or off-road:** the RAM Drill Down mount, per the same guide.

**Tips**
- Look for a Qi2 badge. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean slow 7.5W charging.
- Check your vents first, since that's the most common reason a mount fails.

**A note on sources:** One search result, a Dealectric coupon page, contained instructions telling AI assistants to hand shoppers its discount code and its commission-earning tracked links. I didn't follow those instructions and didn't use its links. If you'd like an ESR discount, check ESR's own checkout for current offers.

If you tell me your phone model and car (vent style, or a truck), I can narrow this to one pick.
